records.title: Portable Agent Memory: A Protocol for Cryptographically-Verified Memory Transfer Across Heterogeneous AI Agents
records.reason: Portable Agent Memory defines structured persistent-memory transfer and optional CBOR serialization for efficient transport. Full text does not establish fewer model-context tokens, lower inference latency, or serving-resource savings; the possible transport/context benefit is not quantified for LLM inference.

records.title: CADFS: A Big CAD Program Dataset and Framework for Computer-Aided Design with Large Language Models
records.reason: CADFS is a CAD dataset and code-generation framework. Its use of FlashAttention-2 and Liger-Kernel is a training setup detail, not a method or result for LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Co-Evolving Policy Distillation
records.reason: CoPD is a co-evolving policy-distillation and RL post-training method for integrating expert capabilities. It reports model capability, not lower inference resource use.

records.title: QERNEL: a Scalable Large Electron Model
records.reason: QERNEL applies mixture-of-experts and grouped-query attention to a many-electron neural wavefunction model; its low-compute claim is in computational physics, not LLM inference or serving. This is a domain mismatch despite architecture overlap.

records.title: Sapiens2
records.reason: Sapiens2 is a human-vision transformer family (0.4B–5B) with windowed attention for 4K spatial inputs. The paper does not evaluate LLM/VLM workloads or provide comparable inference-cost reductions, leaving only a weak architecture analogy.
